0022600137.text: The Knicks (0-3) are heading into their fifth game of the season on a three-game losing streak, sitting 13th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, while the Bulls (1-3) have lost two straight and sit 11th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Central. New York will be without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain, and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring, out), with Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-96 win in New York on April 3, 2026.
